source.excerpt: Flat exports come straight from the motif; every 3D component reads the same contours.
source.context: Project record: its stated design constraints have project authority.

recorded_directions.claim: Flat exports and 3D components use the same primary motif contours.
recorded_directions.scope: Mandatory: every candidate must meet this direction.

source_shared_master_directions.instructions: Do `recorded_directions` retain every explicit design instruction, preference, prohibition and open choice in `source.excerpt`?

criteria.true: Each explicit direction is recorded with the source's authority and scope. Descriptive business facts and feedback about a previous artifact are not new design instructions. A source without design directions needs none invented.
criteria.false: An explicit direction is missing, its authority is weakened, or its mandatory, preference, prohibition or open-choice scope is changed.
